newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arab drugs 95/6 dividend at 4.50 pounds.
newsitem.headline: Arab drugs 95/6 dividend at 4.50 pounds.

text.p: Egypt's Arab Drugs and Chemical Industries will distribute a 4.50 pound dividend per share for the 1995/96 financial year, a company statement said on Wednesday.
Investors can pick up their yield from branches of the National Bank of Egypt. Dividends for the previous financial year were not available. The years end on June 30.
Audited results showed that net after-tax profits for Arab Drugs and Chemical Industries jumped 34.31 percent in 1995/6 to 6.842 million pounds from 5.094 million in the previous year.

Turnover was 94.125 million pounds, up from 85.222 million in the previous year. The state recently sold the private sector 30 percent, or some 360,000 shares of the company's 1.2 million shares, at 40.00 pounds a share.
